objective: Pin the mechanism of the decomposition-dependent adjoint gradient on the case that proved it, by running the three discriminating experiments from the liaison memo in their stated cost order
rationale: A4's verdict closed on 2026-08-04: the published 10.04 percent adjoint error is an artifact of the default scotch decomposition, confirmed by an adversarial supervisor sweep whose own independent re-run reproduced the np 2 cell to every printed digit. At fixed rank count four the analytic gradient reads 8.95 percent from its own finite difference under scotch and 0.00054 percent under simple 4x1x1, the converged baseline drag is invariant to five significant figures, and tightening the linear tolerance four orders changes nothing, so it is a converged wrong answer. The liaison's research pass found no upstream report of a decomposition-dependent gradient anywhere, recorded as negative searches, while the toolchain's own journal paper reports average adjoint derivative error under 0.1 percent at up to 1536 cores. A pinned mechanism therefore contradicts a published upstream claim, which is the literature charter's trigger three, and the liaison recorded the proposal as mandatory once A4 closed. The open reach item asks which other cases the defect touches; this one pins the mechanism on A4 itself with the memo's three discriminators, cheapest first: the bitwise primal compare across decompositions, the cross residual of the scotch adjoint vector evaluated under the serial operator, the volume-mesh coordinate gradient compared across decompositions, the preconditioner matrix dumped under both decompositions and diffed in global cell ordering, and a coloring-off run last. Prediction, written before any run: the cross residual will be large, because the tolerance-ball mechanism it discriminates was already disfavoured when four orders of tightening moved nothing. Axis scores: gate three over forty-five on knowledge per core-min, zero wall row, zero challenge columns. HARD criterion 1, three-dimensional separated flow on the Ahmed 25 degree body, an existing family. Every deciding run's log and case dictionaries are retained under the campaign.
gate: Either one mechanism is named, with the discriminator that convicted it and its logs cited, or all three discriminators are recorded as run with their outcomes and the mechanism is bounded to what none of them can see. A matrix diff counts only after both dumps are permuted to the same global cell ordering, a cross residual is judged against the serial operator's own scale, and nothing is claimed about any gradient without the finite difference column beside it
cost_basis: measured: A4 adjoint checks on this box cost 2.1 to 2.9 core-min per arm at two to four ranks, and the supervisor sweep's own independent re-run measured 2.9. The ladder is at most ten such arms plus one coloring-off run budgeted at four arms because finite difference partials replace reverse mode there; the primal compare, the permuted matrix diff and the cross residual are arithmetic on logs and dumped operators at effectively zero solver cost
expected_knowledge_gain: Each outcome changes a decision. A large cross residual with preconditioner entries differing at partition corners convicts the parallel assembly and yields a novel defect report for upstream, where no such report exists and the published claim reads the opposite. A small cross residual makes the loose acceptance gate the cause and changes the linear tolerance policy on every multi-rank gradient the lab publishes. A moving primal or a moving volume-mesh gradient relocates the defect outside the adjoint and reprioritizes the mesh-derivative chain. Three exhausted discriminators with recorded outcomes are a publishable negative that any reconciliation with the upstream claim has to route around
citations: DAFoam journal paper, adjoint derivative error under 0.1 percent at 1536 cores, tier SEARCH-EXCERPT via the liaison memo, abstract only
